in_marathi.name: Apsar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Love and Beauty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Apsar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Apsaras are celestial nymphs or apsaras who are the embodiment of beauty, grace, and charm. They are the attendants of the gods and are responsible for the creation and maintenance of the universe.
